claims: A blood moon occurs during a total lunar eclipse.
Earth passes directly between the Sun and Moon during a total lunar eclipse.
Sunlight scattered through Earth's atmosphere casts a reddish glow on the lunar surface during a total lunar eclipse.
Earth's atmosphere filters sunlight and scatters blue light during a blood moon.
Earth's atmosphere allows only red light to refract onto the Moon during a blood moon.
The intensity of the color of a blood moon depends on atmospheric dust and clouds.
Total blood moons happen roughly every 1 to 2 years.
Total blood moons are not always visible from all locations.
The total eclipse phase typically lasts for over an hour.
The entire partial phase typically lasts several hours.
Pagangrimoire.com notes that blood moons are now primarily viewed as spectacular astronomical events.
The next total lunar eclipse visible in many areas will occur on September 7, 2025.
A total lunar eclipse will occur on December 31, 2028.
Facebook.com/museumofscience notes that a highly visible total lunar eclipse is expected on September 7, 2025.
December 31, 2028 is the next significant total lunar eclipse.
Terraria Wiki states that in the video game Terraria, a Blood Moon is a recurring in-game event.
Terraria Wiki states that a Blood Moon fills the world with a red light in Terraria.
Terraria Wiki states that a Blood Moon often causes dangerous monsters to spawn in Terraria.
